en: Colorized view of a European riverside city with a bridge crossing a blue river, lined by trees and historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the background, a steep wooded hill rises, crowned by fortification walls and buildings; to the right on the hillside stands a prominent clock tower. The caption at the top left reads "GRAZ, Schlossberg," and additional commercial signage is visible on one of the riverside buildings.
